text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "resolutions by the Federal Council and Parliament to withdraw from the use of nuclear energy on a step-by-step basis resulted in the formulation of a new federal energy policy (Energy Strategy 2050)", "gist": "Swiss government resolutions led to a new federal energy policy called Energy Strategy 2050"}, {"type": "date", "quote": "end of 2016", "gist": "Deadline for nuclear power plant operators to withdraw applications"}, {"type": "date", "quote": "May 2017", "gist": "Swiss electorate approved revised Federal Energy Act"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "upon the publication of the initial package of measures for Energy Strategy 2050", "gist": "Approval of revised Federal Energy Act was contingent on publication of initial Energy Strategy 2050 measures"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "granting of new general licences for nuclear power plants was prohibited with effect from 1 January 2018", "gist": "New nuclear power plant licences banned from January 1, 2018"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Mühleberg nuclear power plant", "gist": "A specific nuclear power plant in Switzerland"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Mühleberg nuclear power plant was shut down in December 2019 and is currently being dismantled", "gist": "Mühleberg nuclear plant closed in December 2019 and is now being dismantled"}]}
